historical_failures.name: ORDINARY_SOURCE_PAYLOAD_NOT_BOUND_AFTER_LOAD
historical_failures.root_cause: Ordinary authorization rechecked the backing file identity but did not compare the in-memory export payload to that source.
historical_failures.repair: Reload the externally allowlisted source at export time and require exact payload, case_id, path, blob and canonical payload-digest agreement.

historical_failures.name: FORGED_ORDINARY_CONTEXT_BEARER_CAPABILITY
historical_failures.root_cause: _training_export_context behaved like a transferable bearer capability independent of the payload carrying it.
historical_failures.repair: Treat loader context only as a source locator and verify the carrying payload exactly equals the authenticated ordinary source.

historical_failures.name: ORDINARY_BENCHMARK_CASE_ID_COLLISION_NOT_VALIDATED
historical_failures.root_cause: Policy checks separated benchmark case identity from ordinary-source identity and only compared byte hashes.
historical_failures.repair: Parse ordinary source case_id during policy build and policy validation; reject benchmark/ordinary and ordinary/ordinary collisions.

historical_failures.name: DECLARED_FAMILY_CASE_PATH_CONTAINMENT_MISSING
historical_failures.root_cause: Case path containment was checked only against the broad family root, not the declared family directory; materialization had no equivalent canonical containment check.
historical_failures.repair: Resolve canonical case paths and require containment inside the declared family directory in both policy construction and materialization.
